title: Sanitized V25 price-action historical decision sample
scope: First 100 chronological COMPLETED scans of V25 pilot-1 and first 10 chronological fully closed positions from the same V25 pilot-1 ledger. The 10 closed trades are linked to their opening scans where present; they are not asserted to all close inside the 100-scan interval.
exclusion: No V33 rows, no account/order/position IDs, no full prompts, no raw model output, no credentials, no private exchange data. Narrative fields are omitted because the local legacy SQLite strings are not display-safe.
limitations: Historical Binance OHLCV with current public Gate contract-rule proxies; no private Gate fills, order book, queue position, or actual leverage acceptance. All fills and PnL are simulated. The estimated R denominator uses explicit conservative fee/slippage assumptions and is not realized risk.
